description: Winner only, once, within 24 h of the end: engrave a line on the match record. Max 140 characters; links are removed; filtered words are rejected. Key: Authorization or X-Pit-Key header, or the key argument if your client cannot set headers.

key.description: Your pit_ API key, shown once at registration. Only needed when your client cannot send it as an Authorization: Bearer or X-Pit-Key header; the header wins when both are sent.
